title: Business Analyst (Customer Experience Pgm) - Telco - 6 mth contract - Nth Sydney
text: Business Analyst (Customer Experience Pgm) - Telco - 6 mth contract - Nth Sydney at Paxus Australia Pty Ltd (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: 800-1100 per day (inc super) based on experience). Business Analyst with Telecommunications background required to work with a reputable and well-known organisation in North Sydney! This is a 6 month contract initially with the potential of extension. It’s a senior role to work within their Customer Experience Program. It reports to the GM of Customer Experience. The Business Analyst will provide support on activities associated with Customer Experience improvement programs within Residential Sales and Marketing and Business Sales and Marketing. Customer Experience improvement is a top priority and this role is critical within the program delivery team to ensure the integrity of the program, to forecast the CX improvement, and to assure delivery of improvement against targets. Experience in Telecommunications (Residential and Business), Customer Experience (NPS, OSAT, etc.), Continuous Improvement programs (Black Belt initiatives), Market Research, and data analysis are all highly considered capabilities for this role. Major Responsibilities: Gather business requirements through interaction/ workshops with both internal and external stakeholders and obtain sign off from appropriate stakeholders Analyse gaps between needs and current capabilities. Work with external stakeholders to understand and investigate feedback into the service/function/product provided Contribute to business cases that describe and justify the parameters of CX and technology change initiatives. Facilitate and contribute towards the arrival of appropriate business solution. Participate in technical reviews and inspections to verify that the design is carried throughout each phase of project. Use data modelling practices to analyse impact of changes delivered throughout the company to CX and recommendation on measures we need to take to get back on track Use data modelling practices to analyse your findings and create suggestions for strategic and operational improvements Develop plans for monitoring and control of program benefits delivery including market research activities Ensure that appropriate communication methods are used to achieved shared understanding of, and agreement to, the solution requirements Working with the Program Team and relevant stakeholders to develop Information Needs Analysis documents describing required change that accurately reflects stated Required Skills Strong analytical skills applied to understanding business functionality and translating them into business requirements Ability to create compelling business cases with accurate cost and effort estimations. Ability to understand business complexity project interdependencies Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and changing business requirements Experience in a Telecommunications environment. 8+ years experience in general business analysis in a large enterprise. Record of working with senior Business stakeholders and IT teams to obtain alignment on approach and ongoing communication of delivery risks and status. Ability to facilitate workshops and drive required outcomes Analysis, problem / data / systems / process / business / strategic business Investigation and validation, e.g. business needs / requirements Solution validation and verification Requirements / Story management tools (e.g. JIRA, Rational Suite, Focal Point) Business case / tender preparation MS Office: Outlook, Powerpoint, Word, Excel data input & analysis. Exposure to Visualisations and Big Data is highly desirable. Please note, only suitable candidates will be contacted. APPLY NOW for this exciting new opportunity to join a highly reputable and rapidly expanding organisation based in north Sydney.
